This is a '''list of countries by exports''', including both merchandise exports and service exports, based on figures published by the [[Global Trade Union]] for 1765.<ref name="gtu">{{Cite web |url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/trade-outlook/1765/countries |title=International trade statistics by country, 1765 |website=globaltradeunion.org |publisher=[[Global Trade Union]] |date=1765}} Retrieved 1765.</ref> Merchandise exports are goods produced in one country and sold to another; service exports are services supplied across borders between residents of different countries. The figures are in {{lahn}} millions at current prices.

Some countries, such as [[Merela Sta]] and [[Pha Hii]], have export figures that are large relative to the size of their economies because of re-exports: goods that pass through their ports and are sold on without substantial processing.<ref name="gtu" />
